product_family: RelayThat is a single-product design automation SaaS for turning brand guidelines into consistent marketing images, display ads, and social graphics (one-click resize, headline generator, brand asset library). No separate consumer/enterprise product lines; tiers (Pro, Pro+, Enterprise) differ by seats and collaboration/white-label features, not by security posture.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence - no trust center, security page, or SOC 2 mention found on relaythat.com; privacy policy and terms of service do not reference SOC 2

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence - no ISO 27001 mention found on relaythat.com privacy policy, terms of service, or homepage

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence - no HIPAA mention found anywhere on relaythat.com; product is a marketing image design tool, not positioned for regulated health data

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence - payment processing is referenced generically ("payment processors") in the privacy policy but no PCI DSS attestation is made by RelayThat itself

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence - not mentioned on relaythat.com

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence - not mentioned on relaythat.com; no AI-governance-specific disclosures found

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence - not mentioned on relaythat.com

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence - not applicable/mentioned; RelayThat is a consumer/SMB marketing tool with no government cloud offering referenced

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy references international/EEA data transfers using standard contractual clauses but does not make an explicit formal GDPR-compliance certification claim; treated as a documented posture, not a certification.

privacy.ai_training_note: No statement is found on relaythat.com's privacy policy, terms of service, or homepage regarding whether user-uploaded brand assets or images are used to train AI or machine-learning models, and no opt-out mechanism is documented.
privacy.data_region: United States primarily, with data "stored and processed in United States, or where we or our partners, affiliates and third-party providers maintain facilities" (no specific data center/region named); EEA transfers referenced generically via standard contractual clauses.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Not documented. Privacy policy only states "no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure" with no specifics on TLS or encryption protocols.

security.name: SSO / enterprise auth
security.value: Enterprise tier lists "Branded Sign-In Pages" as a feature; no detail on SSO/SAML protocol support is published.

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: Privacy policy references disclosure to IT providers, data storage hosts, analytics providers, payment processors, and ad networks in general terms; no maintained subprocessor list is published.

security.name: Security/trust page
security.value: No dedicated /security or /trust page exists on relaythat.com (returns 404); no SafeBase, Vanta, Drata, or similar trust-center integration found.

products.name: RelayThat Pro
products.data_scope: Uploaded brand assets, images, fonts, color palettes, generated marketing creatives
products.notes: Single-user or small-team plan; unlimited image downloads, single workspace-level features.

products.name: RelayThat Pro+
products.data_scope: Same as Pro plus shared team access for 2 users
products.notes: Adds basic team collaboration on top of Pro.

products.name: RelayThat Enterprise
products.data_scope: Same brand asset/image data plus data integration features and white-label output
products.notes: Adds branded sign-in pages, large team collaboration, data integration, and white-label options; no distinct security certifications documented for this tier versus lower tiers.

compare.pricing_model: Per-seat subscription (Pro $15/mo, Pro+ $25/mo for 2 users, Enterprise custom pricing)
compare.data_residency: US-primary, unspecified partner facilities; no dedicated EU/regional hosting option documented

flags: No trust center, security page, or third-party audit evidence was found anywhere on relaythat.com; certifications reflect absence of public evidence, not a confirmed negative statement from the vendor.

'Relay' (relaypro.com, a business communication device maker with its own SOC 2, HIPAA Type 2, and ISO 27001 certifications) and 'Global Relay' (a financial compliance messaging company) are different companies from RelayThat Inc. (relaythat.com, design automation for marketing images); their certifications do not apply to RelayThat.
AI-training posture on user-uploaded creative assets is undocumented (neither confirmed nor denied) - worth a direct vendor inquiry before any AI-governance claim is made in a listing.
No DPA (Data Processing Agreement) template or Enterprise SSO/SAML protocol detail is publicly documented, which matters for any enterprise/agency buyer evaluating this tier.
